headline: Resolutions on $632,000 in state funding for schools and on TPS terminations for Haiti and Syria.
summary: The agenda lists a proposed Teen Health Center at Medford High School and a possible enhanced partnership with the Japanese Language School. It also includes resolutions on state funding and on the termination of Temporary Protected Status for Haiti and Syria.
items: Executive session to discuss strategy for Massachusetts Teachers Association (MTA) litigation
